characterList.description: A man in his 20s-30s with a slight beard and brown hair, using a motorized wheelchair. He's wearing a blue shirt, green scarf, and a transparent face mask connected to a tube, with a brown backpack on his wheelchair.
characterList.name: Marvin Hubert

content_metadata.description: Marvin Hubert takes viewers on an exploratory journey along the 'La Boucle Verte' pathway in Saint-Étienne, showcasing its accessibility for wheelchair users.
